experiment.title: Google Webinar vs Demo head-to-head
experiment.hypothesis: In settled campaigns Google Webinar returns more pipeline per dollar than Google Demo; a randomized split will show whether the offer drives it.
experiment.decision_rule: Read on day 42 after attribution settles. If Webinar is at least 25% higher on pipeline per $ than Demo, shift Google budget toward Webinar and repeat the split on Meta before any wider move; if within 25% either way, hold the mix and extend the read; if Demo is at least 25% higher, keep Demo.
